svg.title: CCC / Cognitive-OS V6 — Final Architecture
svg.text: Cognitive Architecture · checkpoint-118 · ADR-116 + ADR-117 + Amendment 01 Accepted
V6 upgrades CCC from an information system into a driver-recognition system.
CORE is not a layer. It governs all layers.
CCC exists to improve judgment, prediction, and action — not to accumulate data.
User = source · Think tank = externalised structure · CCC = technical carrier
Power → Resources → Economy → Technology → Society → Events
Event is not the cause. Event is the manifestation. Driver is the cause. Trace causality upward ≥ 3 layers.
1. CORE governs all layers, but is not itself a layer.
2. Power is the upstream of resource allocation.
3. Events are manifestations, not root causes.
4. Major analysis must trace upward to power & resource allocation.
5. Incomplete info → tolerable error, not false certainty.
7. Unknown risk must be survivable before action.
14. CCC outputs decisions, not just records.
1. Do not call CORE a layer or number it Layer 0.
2. W → Q automatic write-back permanently forbidden.
3. Source must not automatically become truth.
4. Claim must not automatically upgrade to event.
5. Hypothesis must not auto-write into graph edge.
6. Do not open unaudited graph write paths.
7. Do not replicate Q core judgment on W side.
8. Do not modify locked core functions without checkpoint.
9. Do not stop analysis at event layer. Trace higher.
10. Do not use complex structures to replace clear boundaries.
11. No guaranteed-truth framing of CCC decisions.
12. No action when unknown risk exceeds survivable boundary.
13. No single-point dependency in any goal or decision path.
L0–L7 = data workflow · design intent, not DDL*
R0–R7 = reasoning · D0–D5 = driver rank · A0–A4 = action priority
English for structure (DDL, enums, ADR titles, checkpoints, SVG)
Chinese for explanation · Bilingual for public transmission
No uncontrolled mixed naming. Every Chinese term binds to English.
* L0–L7: accepted architecture / design intent · not implemented DDL · future checkpoints required per L-stage · Old P-prefix = historical, not backfilled
Everything below is governed by CORE. Schema, Edge, Sync, Feedback — all serve CORE.
CCC is not an oracle. CCC is a constrained judgment system under incomplete information.
L0–L7 Operational Workflow · design intent · not implemented DDL · L0 Raw → L1 Doc → L2 Claim → L3 Event → L4 Entity → L5 Candidate → L6 Graph Gate → L7 Decision
R3 Essence · R4 Contradiction · R5 Trust Topology — P1–P7 Assessment Pipeline
DO · DO_WITH_CAUTION · WAIT · NO_GO · Truth first · never pre-filtered
W Purpose: convert internal cognition into sustainable public communication · Survivability first
W is not censorship · W does not decide · W does not own judgment
Absorbed (auditable claims only · human approval required)
Becomes evidence · updates graph / timeline / claims · re-enters R0–R7 pipeline
Closes the loop: Reality → Decision → Feedback → Evolution
L0–L7 = data workflow (design intent · not DDL)
SQLV3 Phase 2 Sealed · Phase 2.5 Architecture Closure Sealed · checkpoint-118
107 Feedback Absorption · 110 Edge Identity Design · 113 Edge DDL · 115 Ingest Write Path · 116 W Schema Alignment
ADR-116 W Layer Re-definition — Accepted · ADR-117 CCC V6 Chain Structure — Accepted
ADR-117 Amendment 01 CORE Epistemic & Architecture Boundary — Accepted · checkpoint-118
Phase 1 = knowledge base · Phase 2 = cognitive system · Phase 2.5 = architecture expressed
✓ CORE: Mission · Driver Chain D0–D5 · 14 Principles (incl. Action Boundary Group 5–8) · 13 Forbidden Rules
✓ Naming Firewall: CORE / L0–L7 / R0–R7 / D0–D5 / A0–A4 · Language Policy v0.1 · checkpoint-118
✓ ADR-116 W Layer · ADR-117 V6 Chain Structure · ADR-117 Amendment 01 Epistemic Boundary — all Accepted
✓ Full feedback loop · Edge Identity · Q/W sovereignty · L0–L7 design intent locked
Disagreement is not noise. Disagreement is diagnostic input. · CCC is not an oracle. CCC is a constrained judgment system under incomplete information.
